factors.name: Hammer at a bottom / star at a top
factors.call: lower_wick[2] >= 0.4 * range[2] and lower_wick[2] >= upper_wick[2] and abs(body[2]) <= 0.4 * range[2] and range[2] >= 0.3 * a[2] and low[2] <= lowest(low, 10)[2] + 0.25 * a[2]
factors.put: upper_wick[2] >= 0.4 * range[2] and upper_wick[2] >= lower_wick[2] and abs(body[2]) <= 0.4 * range[2] and range[2] >= 0.3 * a[2] and high[2] >= highest(high, 10)[2] - 0.25 * a[2]

factors.name: Covered by a candle of the opposite colour (at least half the setup)
factors.call: red[1] and min(high[1], high[2]) - max(low[1], low[2]) >= 0.5 * range[2]
factors.put: green[1] and min(high[1], high[2]) - max(low[1], low[2]) >= 0.5 * range[2]

factors.name: Decisive candle back the other way, closing past the covering candle's open
factors.call: green and body >= 0.5 * a and body >= abs(body[1]) and close > open[1]
factors.put: red and body <= -0.5 * a and -body >= abs(body[1]) and close < open[1]
